name: notion
description: Search, read and write the user's Notion pages (integration token)
capability_note: You can search and read the user's Notion pages, append notes to a page and create pages — but only pages they have shared with your integration are visible.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search the user's Notion workspace for pages and databases.

tools.name: notion_read
tools.description: Read a Notion page as Markdown.

tools.name: notion_append
tools.description: Append text to the end of a Notion page.

arg.description: Pipe-separated: page id or URL|text to append

tools.name: notion_create
tools.description: Create a new Notion page under an existing page.

arg.description: Pipe-separated: parent page id or URL|title|markdown body
